Akshay (Procurement): Heads-up — HyperShip says 8 H100 replacements arrived at FRA transit hub but DE depot refused intake citing thermal sensor mismatch on 3 units. Vendor offers refurb or swap. Thoughts?
Maria (Ops): Ugh. Can depot provide rejection photos + log? We need evidence for insurance and vendor RMA.
Emily (Logistics): Got the depot notes — short photo set and `sensor_readout.txt` attached in depot ticket. They flagged variance >3C on boot.
Liam (SRE): Cluster pressure: eu-west-1 GPU pool at 92% allocation; if those 3 are DOA we hit throttles this week. Need loaners or expedite. :grimacing:
Vendor · HyperShip: We can either (A) route 3 cold-swapped refurbished units from our DE hub by crossdock (consolidated AWB) in 5 business days, or (B) air-expedite replacements in 72h at +18% freight. We can pre-clear HS code if Redwood confirms invoice values.
Maria (Ops): Can HyperShip consolidate AWBs to reduce brokerage? Depot hit us with €450 per shipment last time.
Vendor · HyperShip: Yes — consolidation to a single AWB reduces brokerage to ~€120 total. We'll absorb €60 of brokerage if Redwood covers the remainder or issues a credit note for €60 per unit.
Akshay (Procurement): Noted. Proposal: Redwood covers brokerage delta, vendor issues credit note for €180 total on arrival (to simplify). Also need vendor to cover refurb QA or warranty extension for the swapped units.
Vendor · HyperShip: Agree to credit note + 6mo warranty extension on the 3 refurbished units if Redwood signs DOA acceptance variance for thermal delta. We will also pre-file insurance claim for transit damage.
Emily (Logistics): Can we route 3 loaners from UK pool to DE depot asap while we wait? That would buy time for SRE.
Liam (SRE): Yes please. Loaners for 2 weeks would keep rolling. Capacity forecast looks bad after Tuesday without them.
Akshay (Procurement): OK — Emily to confirm loaner pickup. HyperShip to send consolidated AWB + proforma invoice to finance@redwood.com. Maria — can you get depot photos into the ticket and mark as evidence for insurance?
Maria (Ops): On it. Uploading now + pinging depot lead. :white_check_mark:
Vendor · HyperShip: Proforma and AWB emailed. Will dispatch loaner pickup on approval. Please confirm HS values within 4h to avoid hold.
Akshay (Procurement): Confirm — we'll approve HS values and sign DOA variance. Emily, Maria, Liam — I’ll follow up in this thread when finance signs off.
Emily (Logistics): I'll coordinate loaner route and ETA to DE depot, cc Akshay.
Liam (SRE): Thanks. If ETA slips, escalate and we'll spin down noncritical jobs.
Maria (Ops): Depot photos uploaded. Tagging ticket ID #RMA-5921.
Akshay (Procurement): Closing loop — HyperShip, please add the consolidated AWB to RMA-5921 and mark as expedited. We'll proceed with the credit note path. :thumbsup:
